ccd6bfa930.why: Loading directly into ymm0 through ymm7 eliminates all eight register copies before the transpose operations. The unchanged unpacks reproduce every required output, including ymm3, ymm7, and the final values of ymm8 through ymm11.

5e6dc084ac.why: All shifted component registers are live, and combining four arbitrary components still requires three binary OR instructions per output under AVX2.

122768fe9f.why: The three distinct shifts per group must preserve their live results, and AVX2 has no ternary OR to shorten the remaining combinations.

c8e1e2a6b7.why: AVX2 byte-to-dword widening reads the low eight bytes, so each channel also requires a shift and a second widening to produce its other eight outputs.

0271aea058.why: Both saturation stages, the lane reorder, and the live extracted words are needed, while vzeroupper also clears upper halves of other required registers.

350751b017.why: The required packed high-half temporaries prevent removing the extractions, and the saturation stages, lane reorders, and global upper-half clearing remain necessary.

dcc0cfa85a.why: Each channel needs two word-to-dword widenings and an extraction to make the original upper half available to the second widening.

8d634fee86.why: All six widened vectors are required, and AVX2 needs a separate upper-half extraction in addition to the two widenings per channel.

5328eb6d3c.why: AVX2 packing operates separately within each 128-bit lane, so both saturated outputs still require their qword permutations.

d3a66c0bad.why: Each channel requires both signed-dword-to-unsigned-word saturation and a cross-lane permutation to obtain the specified final element order.
